question: Not only the Office of the UN High Commissioner for Human Rights and other international organisations, but also Ukrainian officials themselves, such as Head of the Office of the President of Ukraine, Kyrylo Budanov, and some Ukrainian MPs have acknowledged the existence of facilities in Ukraine where people are unlawfully detained and tortured by members of the Ukrainian security forces and the army.

The perpetrators remain unpunished; however, the healthcare worker who exposed the existence of such a facility in the village of Petropavlivska Borshchahivka was detained and remanded in custody1. 1.
When will the Commission openly condemn such practices in an EU candidate country?
Does the Commission intend to draw any conclusions from the facts set out above?
